_readme: Animal Riddles content pack (epic #460, unit G4; safety.md S1). Curated, never generated.
Each riddle: id, answer (singular, lower case), aliases (also correct), clues (3, hardest first; clue 1 is the
riddle, clues 2-3 are the hints), sound (the CC0 earcon id spliced after the reveal, G12) and band.
Clues never contain the answer or an alias, fit the device's two 40-char lines, and 'little' clues and copy
never say 'wrong' or 'no' (experience.md). 'little' clues are gentle and concrete: nothing about bones, blood,
death, hunting, biting or fear (the NOT_GENTLE list, safety.md S1). apps/api/tests/content-lint.test.ts checks all of it.
